verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own MCP server, so external assistants like Claude or ChatGPT can act on your conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts, and the changelog cites asking Claude to summarize your inbox. Missive also has a built-in assistant with sessions linked to conversations. However, no evidence shows cross-inbox Q&A such as who said what or what's outstanding, nor that answers are grounded with citations; the only documented grounded answers come from Missive's help docs. missing for 10: documented cross-inbox/calendar question answering in the native assistant, grounding/citation of answers to source messages, outstanding-item detection, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
a conversation links back to the sessions attached to it.
